mapping.formula: x_target = uniform_scale*x_source + tx; y_target = uniform_scale*y_source + ty
mapping.use: Fixed image-plane comparison transform for every frame; never independently normalize each frame because that would erase the jump and fall.
mapping.warning: This is a 2D crop/zoom mapping, not an inferred 3D camera calibration.

source_threshold: R<145,G<135,B<130; largest area/distance-scored connected component in manually seeded, interpolated search ROI
limitations: Image-plane dark-region measurements only. Masks exclude light teeth/tongue. ROI interpolation is a search aid, not measured motion; clipping/occlusion flags must be respected. No 3D angles or depths measured.
